subject: Irish Music and Medford Brewing Taproom Development
overview: Host Danielle Balocca interviewed Medford residents Shannon Heaton and Max Heinegg regarding their artistic contributions and community-focused projects. The discussion highlighted Heaton's Irish music podcast and Heinegg's plans for a new physical taproom for the Medford Brewing Company.

items.title: Interview with Shannon Heaton
items.summary: Musician Shannon Heaton discussed her background in Irish traditional music, the community-building aspects of inclusive local sessions, and her podcast, *Irish Music Stories*, which examines social themes through the lens of music and dance.

items.title: Interview with Max Heinegg
items.summary: Teacher and artist Max Heinegg detailed his creative work and outlined the development of the Medford Brewing Company, including a timeline for opening a community-centered taproom and performance venue on Harvard Avenue in 2022.
